title: Emergency Leave in Saudi Arabia as Per Law: An Ultimate Guide
description: Faced with an emergency in Saudi Arabia? Unsure about your leave rights? This guide explains everything on emergency leave in Saudi Arabia.

breadcrumb.name: Emergency Leave in Saudi Arabia as Per Law: An Ultimate Guide

contentHtml:
Like in many other countries, Saudi Arabia may require time off work due to emerging situations. These situations, which are commonly referred to as emergencies, force employers to balance maintaining business operations with satisfying the expectations of their workforce. Emergency leave in Saudi Arabia enables workers to address urgent matters without fear of repercussions from their employers.

The labor law allows for emergency leave in specific circumstances. Employees can avail themselves of up to five days of paid emergency leave annually. They can get approval for emergency leave for;

  • Death or critical illness of close family members
  • Personal emergencies requiring immediate attention
  • Natural disasters affecting the employee’s circumstances

What Does Emergency Leave in Saudi Arabia Mean?

Emergency leave in Saudi Arabia is a limited paid leave for employees, which is acceptable for critical conditions. Employees can claim emergency leave to handle accidents, sudden illness, severe disease, viral infections, natural disasters, or the death of a dependent. These emergency leave may need evidence and relevant documents for leave approval. Employer can refuse or accept the leave application based on their company policies.

Eligibility for Saudi Emergency Leave

The eligibility criteria for emergency leave may be different according to company leave policies. Usually, permanent employees with valid employment contracts are eligible for emergency leave at work in Saudi Arabia. Temporary employees or employees on probation may have emergency leave but it’s unpaid, and approvals depend on the conditions.

The employee may be required to provide supportive documents, such as medicines and hospital slips, to obtain emergency leave. However, the requirements for emergency leave approval may differ according to the company policies.

Death in the family

Saudi employees can acquire emergency leave for the funeral or upon the death of a family member, such as children, parents, siblings, and spouses. They may require supportive documents for evidence, like a death certificate.

Serious illness

Saudi employees may be eligible for an emergency leave of absence from work in case of severe disease, viral infections, or a family member who suffers from serious illness. Their sickness must be severe and require serious attention and extra care. Medical certificates or other relevant documentation may be necessary to support the leave application.

Emergency Leave in Saudi Arabia As Per Labor Law

Saudi labor law emphasizes the importance of relief in case of accidents, unforeseen crises, natural disasters, or the death of a family member and allows emergency leave in KSA. Such emergency leave is paid leave and allows for a limited period annually. The common purposes of emergency leave are accidents, severe disease, viral attacks, natural disasters, or death of dependents. Companies have different criteria for emergency leave approvals, and some employers require evidence with supportive documents. Their eligibility requirements may differ according to their company policies. Employees must recognize company leave policies and regulations before applying for leave.

Employee Rights and Obligations for Emergency Leave

Saudi employees have the right to obtain paid emergency leave for emergencies. Obligations include providing necessary documentation to support the leave claim. Employers must respect the employee’s absence and ensure continued benefits. Both parties should maintain clear communication to facilitate a smooth return to work.

Employee Rights

Employees in Saudi Arabia have the right to take emergency leave for qualifying reasons like family illness or death. They are entitled to full pay during this period. Employers refuse to approve emergency leave.

Additionally, employees retain their employment benefits and seniority during the leave.

Taking Leave

Emergency leave days allow employees to address urgent personal crises. In Saudi Arabia, employees have the right to a specific number of paid days off for such emergencies. Common reasons include family illness or death. Employers cannot retaliate for using this leave and must maintain employee benefits during the absence. Proper documentation is usually required to support the leave claim.

Approval Process

Employees requesting emergency leave in Saudi Arabia must typically follow their company’s approval process. This usually involves notifying a supervisor or HR department promptly and providing necessary documentation. While the employer has the right to verify the emergency, employees also have the right to a timely decision and clear communication about the approval status.

Privacy

Employees have the right to privacy regarding the nature of their emergency when taking leave in Saudi Arabia. Employers should not demand excessive details about personal matters. While providing supporting documentation is often necessary, the information shared should be relevant to the leave request. Respect for employee privacy is essential during these challenging times.

Employee Obligations

Saudi employees have the right to obtain paid emergency leave while they have some responsibilities. They need to provide timely notice for absence and proper emergency leave application with valid reasons. They must cooperate with team and co-workers to hand over workload during their absence, employer’s leave application approvals, and provide relevant documents for evidence. it need to reduce the disruptions at work and return to work as their crises are resolved.

Notification

Employees in Saudi Arabia have the right to request emergency leave when faced with a crisis. They are generally expected to provide timely notification to their employer. This allows the company to arrange for necessary coverage and minimize work disruptions. While the specific notice period may vary, it’s important to inform the employer immediately after the emergency arises. However, emergency leave during the probation period can’t be paid leave, but the approval may depend on the employer’s policies.

Documentation (Potential)

While employers may request documentation to verify an emergency in Saudi Arabia, employees have the right to privacy. Sharing personal information should be limited to what’s necessary. Excessive documentation can be burdensome and invasive. It’s important to balance the employer’s need for verification with the employee’s right to privacy.

Returning to Work

Upon returning to work after emergency leave in Saudi Arabia, employees have the right to resume their previous position or an equivalent role. Employers cannot discriminate against employees for taking approved leave. Any accrued benefits or seniority should be maintained. Employees should be given reasonable time to readjust to work responsibilities after a stressful period.

How do you Apply for Emergency Leave in KSA?

To apply for an emergency leave in Saudi Arabia, inform your supervisor immediately, complete a leave request form, and provide necessary documentation (e.g., death certificate, medical report). Follow your company’s specific procedures for approval.

Inform Your Employer Immediately

Notify your supervisor or HR department as soon as possible about the emergency. Explain the situation clearly and request emergency leave. Follow your company’s guidelines for documentation and approval.

Follow Up with a Formal Request

Submit a written leave application detailing the reason for the leave, requested dates, and contact information. Attach supporting documents like medical certificates or death certificates. Follow your company’s specific leave application procedures.

Sample of Emergency Leave Letter Saudi

Concern Manager’s Title,

I am requesting an emergency leave from the start date to the end date.

(Briefly explain the emergency, e.g., “Due to a sudden and critical illness of my father, I need to be present to provide immediate support.”)

I understand the urgency of this matter and have informed my team about my absence. I assure you that my ongoing projects are not disrupted.

Thank you for your understanding and prompt attention to this request.

Sincerely,

Your Name

Your Designation

Contact Information

Note: Always include any necessary supporting documents (medical certificates, death certificates, etc.) with your leave application.

Final Words

Make clear yourself with your company’s policies, and remember to document your leave properly. Timely communication with your employer is essential. Prioritize your well-being and family during emergencies, knowing your rights and obligations.

FAQs:

What is considered emergency leave in Saudi Arabia?

Emergency leave in Saudi Arabia is granted for urgent personal or family matters, such as illness, death, or other unforeseen situations.

How many days of emergency leave can an employee take in Saudi Arabia?

The number of emergency leave days depends on company policy, as Saudi Labor Law does not specify a fixed duration.

What documents are required to apply for emergency leave?

Employees usually need to provide supporting documents, such as a medical certificate or death certificate, depending on the reason.

Can emergency leave be combined with other types of leave in Saudi Arabia?

Yes, emergency leave can be combined with annual or unpaid leave, subject to employer approval.

Does emergency leave affect salary or end-of-service benefits?

If emergency leave is paid, it does not affect benefits. However, unpaid emergency leave may slightly reduce total service time used in gratuity calculations.
